name: a_calendar_events
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Macro & event calendar.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Economic releases (time, consensus, prior), Fed speakers (time), Treasury auctions, investor/analyst days, FDA PDUFA dates, conferences, options expiry, index rebalances, lockup expiries from the brief date through the next 5 NYSE sessions.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## Macro / Calendar
- **S&P Global Services PMI**, September final, was scheduled for **09:45 ET on Monday, October 5**; consensus was **58.7** versus **58.7** prior. (FXEmpire, Oct. 5, 06:59 ET)[15]
- **S&P Global Composite PMI**, September final, was scheduled for **09:45 ET on Monday, October 5**; consensus was **58.4** versus **56.0** prior. (KuCoin, Oct. 5, 10:23 ET)[13]
- **ISM Services PMI**, September, was scheduled for **10:00 ET on Monday, October 5**; published calendar estimates ranged from **55.1 to 55.7**, versus **55.4** prior. (LiveTradingNews, Oct. 5, 09:21 ET)[1] (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 18:06 ET)[9]
- ISM Services subindices scheduled for **10:00 ET on October 5** included business activity, employment, new orders and prices; prior readings were **61.7**, **47.8**, **60.9** and **72.6**, respectively. (Dow Jones Newswires, Oct. 2, 12:56 ET)[7] (KuCoin, Oct. 3, 06:23 ET)[13]
- **Employment Trends Index**, September, was scheduled for **10:00 ET on October 5**; the prior reading was **108.53**, with no consensus listed in the cited calendar. (Dow Jones Newswires, Oct. 2, 12:56 ET)[7]
- The **Federal Open Market Committee minutes** from the **September 15–16 meeting** were scheduled for release at **14:00 ET on Wednesday, October 7**. (Schwab Network, Oct. 4, 19:47 ET)[4]
- **Consumer Credit**, August, was scheduled for **15:00 ET on Wednesday, October 7**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 14:35 ET)[5]
- **Initial jobless claims** for the week ending October 2 were scheduled for **08:30 ET on Thursday, October 8**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 14:35 ET)[5]
- **Wholesale inventories**, August, were scheduled for **10:00 ET on Thursday, October 8**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 14:35 ET)[5]
- Preliminary **University of Michigan consumer sentiment**, October, was scheduled for **10:00 ET on Friday, October 9**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 14:35 ET)[5]

## Macro / Federal Reserve
- **Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan** was scheduled to speak at **18:00 ET on Monday, October 5**; an additional Logan appearance was listed at **23:00 ET**. (Schwab Network, Oct. 4, 19:47 ET)[4] (Trading Economics, Oct. 4, 15:08 ET)[2]
- **Federal Reserve Governor Michelle Bowman** was scheduled to speak at **14:45 ET** during the week of October 5. (Trading Economics, Oct. 4, 15:08 ET)[2]
- **Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams** was scheduled to speak at **13:05 ET** during the week of October 5. (Trading Economics, Oct. 4, 15:08 ET)[2]
- **Federal Reserve Governor Michelle Bowman** and **Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller** were identified as scheduled speakers for Tuesday, October 6 and Thursday, October 8, respectively. (LiveTradingNews, Oct. 5, 09:21 ET)[1]

## Macro / Treasury
- The U.S. Treasury was scheduled to auction **3- and 6-month bills at 11:30 ET on Monday, October 5**. (Schwab Network, Oct. 4, 19:47 ET)[4]
- A **$58 billion 3-year Treasury note auction** was scheduled for **13:00 ET on Tuesday, October 6**. (LiveTradingNews, Oct. 5, 09:21 ET)[1]
- A **$39 billion 10-year Treasury note auction** was scheduled for **13:00 ET on Wednesday, October 7**. (Moomoo, Oct. 3, 05:47 ET)[10]
- Three Treasury auctions were scheduled during the week of October 5–9. (Moomoo, Oct. 3, 05:47 ET)[10]

## Retail / **STZ**
- **Constellation Brands** was scheduled to report quarterly results on **Tuesday, October 6**. (CNBC, Oct. 2, 14:35 ET)[5]

## Consumer Staples / **PEP**
- **PepsiCo** was scheduled to report quarterly results on **Thursday, October 8**. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 18:06 ET)[9]

## Airlines / **DAL**
- **Delta Air Lines** was scheduled to report third-quarter results on **Friday, October 9**. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 18:06 ET)[9]

## Macro / Calendar
- The cited October 5–9 calendars listed **no major U.S. company results for Monday, October 5**. (CMC Markets, Oct. 2, 18:06 ET)[9]
- The cited calendar listed **no options-expiry, index-rebalance, lockup-expiry, investor-day, conference, or FDA PDUFA item** with a specific date in the October 5–9 window.
